title: Guilin or Zhangjiajie for a First China Trip? The Expert's Verdict | China Travel Expert
description:
Guilin or Zhangjiajie for your first trip to China? My pick won't be popular.

Zhangjiajie gives you the "Avatar" mountains — 3,000+ quartz-sandstone pillars, a ¥239 four-day park pass, and a ¥65 ride up the Bailong cliff elevator — but it means hikes, shuttles and queues. Guilin is the opposite: one slow boat down the Li River, ¥215 for the 60 km cruise from Guilin to Yangshuo, past the karst peaks printed on the back of the ¥20 note. For a first-timer I'd pick Guilin every time — less climbing, more postcard. Zhangjiajie is the better trip; save it for your second.

🧭 Expert Tip: book both parks online in advance — tickets are real-name (实名制), so bring your actual passport to the gate, not a photocopy.

第一次来中国，先去桂林还是张家界？我的答案可能不受欢迎。
